svg.title: Conservation Officer blazer emblem — modern achievement
svg.desc: Clean authored reconstruction: smooth explicit geometry, outlined captions, and named native armorial components. Fine embroidered lettering, exact thread colours and stitch structure are not retained. Outlined type is a source-similar substitute. The photographed helmet/mantling and full modern achievement are kept distinct from the earlier blazer arms. The native uploaded modern arms are reused; fine gold stitch treatment is not an official embroidery master.
